children: Beyond Meat regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid-price requirement after its shares closed at $1.00 or higher for 10 consecutive business days.
Nasdaq notified Beyond Meat on March 4, 2026 of noncompliance for 30 straight business days under Rule 5450(a)(1).
Company was given until August 31, 2026 to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid-price rule.
On August 28, 2026 Nasdaq confirmed Beyond Meat's shares closed at $1.00+ for 10 consecutive business days (Aug 14–27), restoring compliance.
Nasdaq closed the matter but Beyond Meat cautioned it may not be able to maintain compliance in the future.
